subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She ______ the book to her friend.
solution:
The correct answer is '**lent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**lent**" is the correct past tense of the verb "**lend**" (उधार देना).
 
• The sentence requires the past tense as it describes a completed action.
 
• The other options: "**laned**," "**leant**," and "**lend**" do not fit grammatically or contextually.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She lent__ the book to her friend.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Laned:** Not a valid word in this context.
 
• **Leant:** Past tense of "lean," meaning to incline or bend.
 
• **Lend:** Present tense of "lend," meaning to give something temporarily.
